## Systems
- CAFE.PLATFORM (in production · on the floor daily) — staff-competition & BI platform an independent Tel Aviv café runs on: live sales competitions on the bar iPad tied to real inventory so expiring stock sells first, owner dashboards on live POS telemetry. Releases ship behind a validation gate: measurable sales lift and expiry-waste reduction over a six-week window decide validate / pivot / kill. Python · FastAPI · PostgreSQL · React · Docker.
- WHATSAPP.BOT (running 24/7 · home server) — an assistant that answers WhatsApp in my voice: voice-matched drafting from chat history with an approval dashboard, commitment detection into Google Tasks/Calendar. Drafts approved without edits >70%. TypeScript · Baileys · Gemini · React 19 · SQLite.
- TANK.SENSOR (deployed · kitchen counter) — the espresso machine that texts me: capacitive sensor + ESP32 + Telegram alerts when the tank runs empty. Zero false alarms in 30 days. C++ · ESP32 · PlatformIO.
